title: Coalesce live-review wakes per package: when a reviewer for a package is still running, route new events for that package to it (one row per review_id) instead of spawning a new session per event
note: MEASURED 2026-10-29: ict_scalp_sol_5m pkg-e5f8bcda8cfa4ae5 (bybit_1 paper) raised 3 wakes in 3 min (13:56Z structure_break, 13:58Z adverse_r -0.5, 13:59Z adverse_r -0.75), 3 Sonnet sessions (~$0.4-0.6 each, n=3 earlier reviewer sessions measured $0.39-$0.60). On 5m legs the -0.5/-0.75 ladder fires inside one bar. Not a new gate: every event still gets a review row; only the session count changes. Design decision for the lane: coalesce in the manager dispatch (send_message to the live reviewer) vs a VM-side batching window.
